scripts.title: Guardians of the Archived Realm
scripts.logline: When civil unrest shatters his vintage archive, a dedicated archivist stands his ground against rioters, inspiring local youth to rally to his defense.
scripts.logline_de: Als bürterliche Unruhen sein Archäologenarchiv verwüsten, verteidigt ein hingebungsvoller Archivar seinen Platz gegen Aufständische und inspiriert lokale Jugendliche.

setting.location: Neotokyo Commercial District, fictional neo-urban setting
setting.time: Late afternoon, amber sunset filtering through thick smog
setting.weather: Hazy, swirling paper debris caught in an urban updraft
setting.color_palette: Deep amber, warm terracotta, gritty dark greys, neon turquoise accents
setting.art_style: 1990s retro anime, cel shading, heavy film grain, dramatic lighting, impact frames, speed lines

characters.name: Ren
characters.design_sheet: 1990s retro anime male, age 32, sturdy build, short messy dark green hair, fierce intense amber eyes, wearing an oversized black hoodie with a faded neon-green abstract graphic on the chest, dark baggy trousers, serious expression
inspired_by_scene_de: Körpersprache mit verschränkten Armen im Türrahmen
changed_de: Keine Logos oder echten Marken, stattdessen fiktives neon-grünes Grafik-Design
characters.voice: Gravelly, deep, resolute voice with a powerful classic 90s English dub heroic timbre

characters.name: Kaito
characters.role: Neighborhood youth stepping in to de-escalate
characters.design_sheet: 1990s retro anime male teen, age 18, lean athletic build, messy blue spiky hair, determined bright blue eyes, wearing a white utility jacket over a grey t-shirt, light jeans, desperate expression

shots.camera: Medium shot, low angle, slow push-in
shots.action: Ren stands inside the shattered storefront frame, debris and glowing paper scraps swirling around him in the amber twilight.

dialogue.line_ja: ふざけるなっ！ここは通さない！
dialogue.line: Don't you dare! You're not crossing this line!

sfx: Shattering glass echoed with deep sub-bass reverb
shots.music: High-octane 90s synth-rock intro with driving electric bass
shots.image_prompt: 1990s retro anime screencap, cel shading, c1 Ren with short messy dark green hair, fierce amber eyes, oversized black hoodie with neon-green graphic, standing inside a shattered storefront frame with flying debris, dramatic rim lighting, film grain
shots.motion_prompt: Camera pushes in slowly as debris swirls violently around Ren, speed lines flashing in the background.

shots.camera: Extreme close-up on Ren's eyes, Dutch angle
shots.action: Ren's eyes narrow intensely as street lights flicker above the chaotic avenue.
shots.voiceover: This place... holds the memories of everything we built.
shots.voiceover_ja: この場所は…私たちが築いたすべての記憶を宿している。
shots.music: Driving synth-rock continues with a soaring melody
shots.image_prompt: 1990s retro anime screencap, cel shading, extreme close-up of c1 Ren's intense amber eyes, dark green bangs framing his face, gritty cel shading, dramatic shadow contrast, film grain
shots.motion_prompt: Camera zooms rapidly into Ren's glowing pupil with an impact frame flash.

shots.camera: Wide shot, tracking forward fast along the chaotic street
shots.action: Pivoting down the avenue, shadowy figures in dark gear surge forward past damaged shopfronts amidst floating papers.
sfx: Muffled angry shouts and running footsteps
shots.music: Aggressive electric guitar riff builds tension
shots.image_prompt: 1990s retro anime screencap, cel shading, wide street view filled with scattered papers and debris, silhouetted rioters in dark clothing surging forward under amber streetlamps, highly detailed architectural buildings in background, film grain
shots.motion_prompt: Fast tracking forward shot simulating handheld camera rush through the crowd.

shots.action: Ren braces his stance as a dark-clad figure lunges toward him with a hostile gesture.
sfx: Flesh impact sound with a bright white flash frame
shots.image_prompt: 1990s retro anime screencap, cel shading, c1 Ren in black hoodie bracing his arms in a defensive stance, aggressive assailant lunging from the side, dynamic action pose, cel-shaded shadows, film grain
shots.motion_prompt: Fast punch motion from the attacker with an impact frame freeze and radial speed lines.

shots.action: Kaito steps in front of Ren, spreading his arms wide with a determined expression to block the approaching conflict.

dialogue.line_ja: やめろ！もうこれ以上はさせない！
dialogue.line: Stop it! No more of this!

sfx: All background noise cuts out instantly into a ringing tone
shots.music: Music drops to a tense, expectant ambient hum
shots.image_prompt: 1990s retro anime screencap, cel shading, c2 Kaito with messy blue spiky hair and white utility jacket standing protectively with arms spread, c1 Ren visible behind him, street setting, dramatic lighting, film grain
shots.motion_prompt: Kaito steps firmly into frame with sudden momentum, wind blowing back his blue hair.

shots.camera: Close-up on Kaito's determined face, slight low angle
shots.action: Kaito stares down the aggressors, his blue eyes reflecting the flickering neon lights of the street.

dialogue.line_ja: この街を守るんだ…一緒に！

shots.music: Uplifting synth arpeggio swells into the mix
shots.image_prompt: 1990s retro anime screencap, cel shading, close-up of c2 Kaito's determined face, blue eyes glowing with resolve, neon reflections on his cheek, dramatic rim light, film grain
shots.motion_prompt: Camera pushes in slowly on Kaito's face as his eyes flare with energy.

shots.action: A surge of blue and amber energy auras erupts around Ren and Kaito, pushing the hostile crowd back as shattered glass floats weightlessly.
sfx: Powerful energy shockwave blast with thunderous roar
shots.music: Full symphonic 90s anime battle theme reaches its peak crescendo
shots.image_prompt: 1990s retro anime screencap, cel shading, c1 Ren and c2 Kaito standing side-by-side surrounded by glowing blue and amber aura flames, floating glass shards refracting light like diamonds, epic shonen pose, film grain
shots.motion_prompt: Explosive energy aura expands outward from characters with swirling particles and intense camera shake.

shots.camera: Medium shot, slow pull back into the dark shop interior
shots.action: The energy settles into a warm amber glow. Ren and Kaito stand firm together amidst the ruins, refusing to back down.
shots.voiceover: Some places are worth fighting for, no matter the ruins left behind.
shots.voiceover_ja: 守るべき場所がある。どんな廃墟になろうとも。
sfx: Gentle wind chime sound echoing softly
shots.music: Melancholic yet hopeful synthesizer chord fading out
shots.image_prompt: 1990s retro anime screencap, cel shading, c1 Ren and c2 Kaito standing resolutely inside the damaged storefront glowing under warm amber light, debris scattered around, calm defiant atmosphere, film grain
shots.motion_prompt: Camera pulls back slowly, framing the two figures steadfast against the ruined backdrop.

music.mood: Epic 90s retro anime synth-rock transitioning into a heroic, emotional orchestral theme

source.event: Vor einem Ladenlokal in einer Einkaufsstraße liegen Scherben und Gegenstände auf dem Boden. Ein Mann verteidigt den beschädigten Eingangsbereich eines Geschäfts, wird dabei von Passanten konfrontiert und körperlich angegriffen. Umstehende greifen deeskalierend ein und rufen zum Aufhören auf, woraufhin der Mann sichtbar mitgenommen im zerstörten Schaufensterrahmen stehen bleibt.
